ERS presents trends, statistics, and charts related to food security, along with definitions, background, key publications, and resources. stories.evidence_text: Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) | Commonwealth of Pennsylvania SNAP, formerly known as food stamps, provides food assistance to eligible low-income Pennsylvanians, offering EBT Cards to purchase fresh, healthy foods. Check your eligibility and apply online.
